newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian govt wins second vote on labour pact.
newsitem.headline: Italian govt wins second vote on labour pact.

text.p: The lower house of parliament's labour commission on Wednesday approved the government's controversial labour bill hours after the same package had been defeated by separate parliamentary commission, officials said.
The bill was initially voted down in the lower house's productive activity commission after a government ally, the hard-left Communist Refoundation, abstained.

In the later vote, Refoundation re-joined government ranks to ensure victory for the bill, which aims to simplify procedures to free up public expenditure on jobs and boost flexibility in the labour market.
The package is due to be voted on in the full lower house on May 14.
Refoundation has protested at measures contained in the bill which are designed to encourage part-time employment.
